clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Rejold's New Brew brings you back to Brewnall Village. After you gathered Shimmerweed, Rejold Barleybrew has perfected a new recipe and wants you, a trusted friend, to sample it.

Tharek Blackstone and Pilot Bellowfiz, your contacts in Dun Morogh, send you back to Brewnall Village. Rejold Barleybrew has finished fermenting his experimental batches and wants to share them with the traveler who made them possible: you, after securing Shimmerweed from the bitter slopes.

Brewnall Village is known for its ale craft, and Rejold Barleybrew’s newest batch is no ordinary draught. He infused his mash with local herbs to make Shimmer Stout. Before shipping barrels to neighboring outposts and thirsty patrons in Loch Modan, Rejold insists that you, the adventurer who risked life and limb for the herbs, have the honor of the first sip.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rejold Barleybrew at Brewnall Village has been asking for you.
He wants to talk to you about a new drink he's been brewing...said something about you helping him with it. You might want to head back to Brewnall Village and see what he has to say.
There could be some free booze in it for you...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend! You know that Shimmerweed you brought me? Well I used it in a few recipes I've been working on, and one of them turned out great!
Here, try it out and tell me what you think...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
